_readme: Category breakdowns for the Demographics detail modal, opened via the 'See full demographics…' link on the L0 Demographics page. Derived by hand from references/conversation-demographics-2026-08-20.csv (437 rows, one per participant profile) — the same source file participant-locations.json's city counts come from. total is every row in the CSV, answered or not. Each category's own answered count is the number of participants with a non-blank value for that field; each breakdown row's pct is that value's share of *only* the participants who answered — not of total — matching the modal's own copy ('Of those N people that provided this information, here is the breakdown'). Each pct is rounded independently for display, the same convention bloom-data.json's vote.pct uses, so a category's rows are not guaranteed to sum to exactly 100. age buckets a continuous field: the youngest bucket reads 'Under 25' rather than the more typical '18-24' because two respondents reported ages 16–17 — the field is self-reported with no minimum enforced upstream, and '18-24' would misstate their own answer. Not touched by scripts/refresh-poll.js, which is a different, Polis-sourced pipeline entirely; re-derive by hand from a fresh demographics CSV export the same way, keeping each category's own answered count as its denominator.
